grids_and_layouts.philosophy: Mobile-first digital business card. Generous padding, high-density actionable areas, optical alignment.

hero_composition.layout: relative min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col items-center overflow-hidden pt-12 pb-24
hero_composition.logo_background: absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3/4 max-w-sm opacity-20 blur-sm
hero_composition.thought_bubble: absolute top-24 right-4 md:right-12 z-20 max-w-[280px] bg-white p-4 shadow-floating
hero_composition.partner_logos: absolute left-4 bottom-32 z-20 flex flex-col gap-2

sections.services: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 px-4 py-12
sections.offices: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 px-4 py-12

entrance.slide_up: transition-transform duration-700 ease-out translate-y-0 starting:translate-y-12 opacity-100 starting:opacity-0

specific_animations.typing_bubble: Typewriter effect for the bio text inside the thought bubble
specific_animations.logo_cycle: Smooth crossfade between partner logos, 1 highlighted at a time
specific_animations.boss_rise: Portrait rises from bottom on initial load

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0B5CB8 meets AA standards. Use #0A1530 for primary text on #E5E7EB.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the typing effect and slider.

components.name: HeroSection
components.description: Full-screen compositional hero with rising portrait, typing thought bubble, and background logo.

components.name: ActionPills
components.description: Floating or bottom-anchored horizontal scroll list of quick actions (vCard, WhatsApp, Call, Email).

components.name: PartnerLogos
components.description: Cycling grayscale logos with active item highlighted (colored or full opacity).

components.name: ContactForm
components.description: Working form saving to DB. Name, Email, Phone, Company, Message. Includes success state.

components.name: OfficeCard
components.description: Address card with map link, using glassmorphism or soft shadow on white surface.

boss_portrait.description: Large cutout portrait rising in front

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements like the thought bubble and action pills.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Retain the original concept (Hero composition, thought bubble, partner logos). Enhance it by applying the defined typography, color scales, and soft shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the thought bubble, use a distinct custom shape (rounded-2xl with a sharp corner pointing to the portrait) and implement a typewriter effect for the bio.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: The bottom action pills should be sticky or fixed at the bottom for easy mobile access, using a glassmorphic background to not obscure the portrait.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build a responsive Contact Form section below the hero. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layout and React state for submission handling. Add a success state.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement the 'Services' and 'Offices' sections as clean, well-spaced cards below the hero. Use lucide-react icons for visual anchors.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Partner logos should be in a grid or stack, visually cycling through them. Grayscale inactive, full color/opacity active.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Use plain React with Tailwind CSS v4. No Shadcn or external UI libraries are strictly required, but lucide-react is permitted for icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Ensure data-testid attributes are present on all buttons, forms, and inputs.
